gaps.sentence: Should the temperature ___ 40 degrees, the system shuts down.
gaps.explanation: Should the temperature exceed… = if it exceeds… — technical register.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ they know that the deal had already collapsed.
gaps.explanation: Little did they know = they had no idea — emphatic idiom with inversion.

gaps.sentence: ___ I richer, I would travel the world.
gaps.explanation: Were I richer = If I were richer — formal inversion.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ this metro line run this late.
gaps.explanation: Rarely at the front: does + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: ___ the second half begin than the rain returned.
gaps.explanation: No sooner did the second half begin than… — inversion with do-support.

gaps.sentence: Seldom have I been so ___ by a performance.
gaps.explanation: 'moved' — the audience was emotionally affected; inversion with have been.

gaps.sentence: ___ the rain to stop, we'll play the match as planned.
gaps.explanation: Should the rain stop = If the rain stops — should + subject + infinitive.
